description: The price range of comparable Boatsite adverts for a boat: the low, middle and high price and the adverts it came from, including ones that have sold. It narrows by make and model, then make, then size, then the whole section, and answers from the first that has enough adverts to be reliable. length_ft narrows to boats within a tenth of that length. When none has, it answers available false with no figure: say that Boatsite has too few comparable adverts to give a range, and never estimate one.

category.description: Section: Narrowboats, Motor boats, Sailing boats, RIBs, Kayaks, Canoes, Paddleboards, Jet skis.

year.description: Narrows the make and model match to three years either side.
